_meta.simulation_note: State as of 2026-08-10. All 100 controls complete (M4 closed Jul 15, on time) - the 14 IAM-blocked controls closed Jul 11-14 following the NEXUS IAM go-live Jul 1. Evidence package delivered to the auditor Jul 15; the auditor failed 3 controls on operating-effectiveness sufficiency Jul 16 (A1.7, CC6.4, CC6.6); remediated Jul 20 - Aug 5 and accepted Aug 7. That finding is what surfaced the certification-date contradiction the program had carried since kickoff, resolved by DR-014. Focus has shifted from control completion to operating stability ahead of the Sep 1 observation window. Full event ledger: 1-inputs-triggers/simulation-log.json.

certification.boardMandateNote: Originally recorded as 'certification by Aug 31, 2026'. That was never achievable: a Type II report attests to controls operating over an observation period, and this engagement's period does not open until Sep 1. The board accepted the restatement on Jul 22 - Aug 31 is readiness, Dec 15 is the report. The contradiction sat unexamined in this record for eleven months and was only forced into the open by the Jul 16 evidence findings.

auditorInteractions.description: SHIELD submitted in-progress evidence package to the auditor. 65 controls complete at time of submission (Waves 1 and 2 partial). Package included policy documents, automated Vanta check exports, and infrastructure configuration screenshots.

The auditor acknowledged receipt of May 12 evidence package. Confirmation that review has commenced. Assigned lead auditor: Marcus Chen (The auditor Cyber Risk). Expected initial findings in 3-4 weeks.

auditorInteractions.description: Full 100-control audit evidence package delivered on target date. Completes SHIELD M4 (100 controls) and M5 (evidence to the auditor) on the same day. Package includes the 14 IAM-dependent controls closed Jul 11-14 following the NEXUS IAM go-live.

The auditor accepted 97 of 100 controls and FAILED 3 on evidence sufficiency. The failures are not implementation defects - every control is built and operating. They are operating-history defects: a Type II report attests that controls operated effectively over a period, and these three had days of history, not months. Escalated to James Whitfield (CISO) same day.

controlOutcomes.auditorNote: Log retention policy closed Jun 30. Policy documentation is complete and correct, but we require evidence of the retention schedule executing across at least one full cycle. Sixteen days of logs is not a retention control operating - it is a retention control existing.

Quarterly access review certification. Control live since Jul 1. A quarterly control with fifteen days of history cannot evidence a completed quarterly cycle. This is the clearest example of the general issue in this package.

Privileged access management. Control live since Jul 1. Provisioning and approval workflows are correctly configured, but we have no sustained record of privileged grants being reviewed and revoked under the new IAM. Compensating documentation from the prior Auth0 workaround period may be acceptable - please propose.

auditorInteractions.auditorContext: Raised proactively by the auditor's engagement partner: the Aug 31 date in NovaGrid's board materials describes a certification we cannot issue. Our observation period opens Sep 1 and closes Nov 30, with the report following Dec 15. We flag this because your board appears to be tracking a date that does not correspond to any deliverable in our engagement letter.

auditorInteractions.description: Remediation plan agreed. A1.7 to be re-evidenced Aug 5 with a full 30+ day retention cycle. CC6.4 and CC6.6 to be supported by compensating documentation covering the pre-IAM period, with full operating history accruing inside the observation window. The auditor confirmed the approach is acceptable in principle pending review of the actual evidence.

remediationCommitments.approach: Re-collect with 30+ days of retention cycle execution
Compensating documentation from the Auth0 workaround period plus a completed off-cycle access review
Compensating documentation of privileged grant reviews under the prior IAM, plus current-state configuration attestation

auditorInteractions.description: Board accepted the restatement of the SOC 2 mandate. James Whitfield (CISO) and Karl Bergstrom presented the auditor's engagement-letter dates against the board's Aug 31 mandate. Outcome: Aug 31 is audit-readiness, Sep 1 - Nov 30 is the observation period, Dec 15 is the Type II report. Recorded as DR-014. Sales was re-briefed the same week; Nuvera Insurance moved to Q4 as a direct consequence.

All three remediated controls accepted. The 100-control evidence package is now complete and accepted for readiness purposes. The auditor confirmed the Sep 1 observation period start. SHIELD M5 re-closed.

controlOutcomes.auditorNote: 38 days of retention cycle execution evidenced. Accepted.
Off-cycle access review completed Jul 30 and compensating documentation accepted. Note for the observation period: this control must evidence a complete quarterly cycle before Nov 30.
Compensating documentation accepted. Privileged grant review cadence must run uninterrupted through the observation period.

auditorInteractions.auditorContext: Readiness confirmed. The engagement now depends on sustained operation rather than further build work. Controls that stop operating cleanly during Sep 1 - Nov 30 will be reported as exceptions, and material exceptions move the Dec 15 report date.
